description: Publishes privacy-minimized, source-defined active NYC DCWP premise-license sites while grouping multiple license rows by the publisher's Business Unique ID.
redirect_policy: Reject redirects and accept only HTTPS requests to the exact data.cityofnewyork.us w7w3-xahh metadata and JSON resource paths.
retry: Retry HTTP 429, 5xx, and transient transport failures with bounded exponential backoff. Do not retry redirects, other 4xx responses, selected-filter drift, schema drift, refresh drift, duplicate Socrata row identity, or quality-gate failures.
checkpoint: Acquire Active/Premises rows in deterministic Business Unique ID, license-number, and Socrata-row order. Hash the complete selected-field source snapshot before grouped normalization. Recheck metadata and filtered count before publication; publish manifest and current pointer last and atomically.
idempotency: The catalog rowsUpdatedAt timestamp plus SHA-256 of the ordered selected-field source artifact identify a source release. Business Unique ID identifies one provisional license-business organization, site, and establishment regardless of active license count.
cancellation: Abort network and local grouping cooperatively, close partition streams, retain unpublished run-scoped staging for diagnosis, and do not change current.json.
retention_profile: Retain immutable internal selected-field source snapshots and local-review-only normalized releases until an approved retention operation removes them.
